_doc: FireRed/LeafGreen Route 22 grass is Rattata 45%, Mankey 45%, Spearow 10%, with no Nidoran: in FRLG the two Nidoran lines live on Route 3, past the demo wall. We add them anyway, Red/Blue style (RBY's Route 22 had Nidoran), so both lines can be met in the demo and Double Kick is an early answer to Brock. New weights: Rattata 35, Mankey 25, Spearow 10, Nidoran F 15, Nidoran M 15, all Lv 2-5. mode 'both' so they roam the route visibly as well as ambushing from tall grass. Spearow is aggressive here (a mean bird), Nidoran F flees. The water on this route is data/encounters/route_22_lake.json. The rival battles on this route are endgame content and deliberately not implemented. B46: rate 21 = FRLG land_mons.encounter_rate (pret src/data/wild_encounters.json sRoute22_FireRed).
